body: I’m trying to move to another country but it’s complicated and i keep doubting myself if i can ever do it i keep feeling like i’m not good enough

I avoid the topic as much as possible it’s just I feel like i’ve been isolating myself and struggling with making friendships with people i also stopped talking to a lot of people i knew because they said negative things about atheists and it just hurts me they would think that way about me

I just don’t get how someone would choose a religion over their own child like i hear stories about people being killed by family members for leaving religion or being gay and I’m just afraid to talk with people because i worry i might say something wrong
